title: Reciprocal associations between positive emotions and motivation in daily life: Network analyses in anhedonic individuals and healthy controls
sample_size: 66 participants in anhedonia group, 68 participants in control group
estimation_packages: DSEM in Mplus Version 8, qgraph Version 1.4.3 in R
limitations: - Did not include contextual features in models; - Relatively large timeframe between assessments (6 hr) may have missed important fluctuations; - Majority of sample was female, limiting generalizability; - Sample was selected based on anhedonia, not psychiatric disorders, limiting generalizability to other populations.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the main text, but the authors may have made them available through supplementary materials or repositories. The study was registered in the Dutch Clinical Trial Register (NTR5498), but this is not the same as preregistration for the specific network analysis hypotheses.
